description: Add or remove services, add an email or webhook destination, publish or hide a read-only public status page, or rename a stack you created. New emails get a confirmation link. Needs the stack id and its management token.

add_email.description: Another email address to notify (must confirm)

add_services.description: Slugs or names to start watching (default rules)

add_webhook_url.description: Another https webhook (Slack/Teams/Google Chat/Discord/Mattermost/Rocket.Chat/JSON) to notify

digest_enabled.description: Turn the weekly email digest on or off for this stack.

monitor_url.description: Add a custom https website monitor (max 3 per stack).

mute_hours.description: 1–168 hours to mute mute_slug, or 0 to clear the mute. Required when mute_slug is set.

mute_slug.description: Catalog service to mute (snooze) on this stack so a known incident does not start a new alert.

opsgenie_api_key.description: Add an Opsgenie API key. The key is never returned.

opsgenie_region.description: Opsgenie API region for opsgenie_api_key. Default us.

pagerduty_routing_key.description: Add a PagerDuty Events API v2 routing key. The key is never returned.

remove_monitor_id.description: Remove a custom monitor by id (mon_…).

remove_services.description: Slugs or names to stop watching

share_enabled.description: Publish (true) or unpublish (false) a read-only live status page. The public URL uses a separate pub_ id, not the private stack id.

share_index.description: Allow search engines to index the public status page. The page stays noindex unless this is true. Ignored when a share password is set.

share_password.description: Set a password on the public status page, or null to clear it. Password-protected pages stay unlisted and cannot be embedded.

token.description: Management token (wdn_...) returned once by create_alert_stack

name: update_alert_stack
title: Change an alert stack
